postings.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
postings.description:
I'm Jen Casson https://www.linkedin.com/in/jencasson/, Senior Director, Product Marketing at Teamworks. I lead our growing team of Product Marketers who support 24+ products across all markets and territories.

I'm looking for someone to own the GTM motion end to end for our Personnel and Coaching product categories, the technology elite teams rely on to evaluate talent, make roster decisions, and prepare for game day. From customer and competitive insights, to positioning and messaging, through to launch and enablement, this person will partner closely with our GTM teams and Executive leadership to drive growth and adoption.


THE ROLE

 - Own market, competitive, and customer insights for our Coaching and Player Personnel product categories across professional, collegiate, and international sports organizations

 - Lead category and competitive positioning, differentiation strategy, and messaging that translates sophisticated analytics into clear customer outcomes

 - Own go-to-market planning and execution for high-priority product launches and category-level initiatives, from customer/market/competitor insights through multi-channel campaign activation

 - Build and maintain the enablement assets, playbooks, battlecards, and training our Sales and Customer Success teams rely on to sell and support these products

 - Use our customer engagement platform (Customer.io http://Customer.io) to help communicate with customers and drive adoption and retention.

 - Define and track KPIs for adoption, launch performance, and campaign effectiveness, turning results into recommendations for Product and GTM stakeholders.

 - Build and maintain AI-driven workflows that support individual and team processes.


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 5+ years of product marketing experience, including senior ownership of go-to-market strategy

 - Proven B2B SaaS experience supporting analytics, business intelligence, or data-driven platforms

 - Experience supporting global markets and multiple customer personas, our buyers range from analytics-savvy front office staff to head coaches

 - Demonstrated ability to lead strategy and execute tactically in a fast-paced environment, this role requires both

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives across Product, Sales, and Customer and Product Success

 - Responsible use of AI tools: you take security and privacy seriously, validate AI-generated outputs before acting on them, and treat AI as an input to your thinking, not a substitute for your judgment. We're still building these workflows, and you'll help shape them


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have experience in the sports, athletics, or performance technology industry

 - You're familiar with tools like Gong, Customer.io http://Customer.io, Gainsight, Omni, ProdPad, or Notion

 - You have hands-on experience with Figma or Photoshop


WHY THIS ROLE

This is a chance to own go-to-market for the products the most elite football, hockey, baseball, and soccer organizations in the world use to decide who to draft, trade, or develop. You'll work at the center of Product, Sales, Customer Success, Product Success, and Executive leadership on a category we're actively scaling, with real room to shape the strategy, not just execute someone else's plan.

postings.title: Account Executive II (Performance)
postings.description:
I'm Conor Branson https://www.linkedin.com/in/conor-branson-258532124/, EMEA Commercial Director at Teamworks, responsible for leading our growth in EMEA across our Performance and Operations product categories. Our Performance category - comprised of our Athlete Management System, Nutrition and Strength & Conditioning systems - has grown significantly over the past two years, and we're looking to add an Account Executive to continue that momentum. We're looking for someone with a technical understanding of athlete performance, and the ability to manage complex deal cycles involving multiple products and stakeholders.

This role requires the Account Executive to have deep knowledge of how performance departments within elite sport function, and the ability to navigate the complexities of the different areas involved: Performance, Medical, Sports Science, Strength & Conditioning, and Nutrition. You'll need strong consultative selling skills, the ability to build relationships across both technical and executive stakeholders, and the confidence to manage long, multi-threaded sales cycles from prospecting through to close. A track record of consistently hitting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets, along with sharp commercial instincts for structuring and negotiating multi-product deals, will be essential.


THE ROLE

 - Build and own a self-generated pipeline of targeted opportunities across the European market, working closely with our marketing and business development teams

 - Drive deals through the full sales cycle, from discovery through negotiation to close, with a consultative approach that puts the customer's real performance needs first

 - Demonstrate the integrated value of AMS, S&C, and Nutrition together, including identifying upsell opportunities within our existing Hub customer base

 - Develop genuine technical fluency in how performance departments operate, so you can map a prospect's real needs to the right solution, not just pitch features

 - Partner with in-territory sales reps across EMEA to provide technical insight and real examples of how other clubs are getting value from the platform


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - Demonstrable, verifiable experience building, progressing, and closing pipeline in a sports technology or elite sporting environment, this is a self-generated pipeline role, not an inherited book of business

 - Self-driven and resourceful attitude, with a track record of taking initiative rather than waiting for direction

 - Genuine team player mindset, with eagerness to partner internally across EMEA commercial team and the wider business

 - Based in the UK, with willingness and ability to travel extensively across Europe; getting in front of people in-market is core to how this role works

 - Fluent English, spoken and written, as this role works across markets and stakeholder groups where English is the operating language


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You're fluent in an additional language such as French or Spanish

 - You have experience selling multi-product or bundled SaaS solutions

 - You've worked closely with or within elite sport performance departments, or have a sports science/performance background


WHY THIS ROLE

This is a chance to help shape how some of the biggest names in sport think about athlete performance. You'll work directly with leading brands across global sport, with real influence over how elite teams use technology to drive athlete performance.

Teamworks is the platform of choice for the world's top sports organizations, and you'll be joining at a moment of real momentum in EMEA, with reference customers already in place and demand accelerating. You'll be backed by a team that's passionate about sport and committed to helping you succeed.

postings.title: Software Engineer II (Frontend)
postings.description:
I'm Rom Paras https://www.linkedin.com/in/rommelparas, Senior Manager, Engineering at Teamworks. AMS (Athlete Management System) is a core product in the Teamworks Performance suite, used by elite sports organizations and high-performance military programs as their single source of truth for physical performance data, medical records, and athlete readiness. We're investing seriously in modernizing the platform, and we're growing the team with a frontend engineer who can take real ownership of the React layer as we build the next generation of AMS.

In this role, you'll be the primary frontend engineer on AMS, building the interactive, data-intensive interfaces that coaches, trainers, and performance staff rely on every day. You'll work closely with backend engineering and design to translate complex data workflows into fast, reliable UI, with real scope and a clear technical direction from day one.


THE ROLE

 - Own the AMS frontend end to end, building and shipping React and TypeScript features from design through production

 - Build complex, data-intensive components including interactive grids, forms, dashboards, and widgets that handle large datasets efficiently using AG Grid

 - Implement and maintain form-building functionality using SurveyJS, and manage application state using React Context or Zustand

 - Integrate frontend components with RESTful APIs and Tanstack Query, partnering with our backend team to keep data flows performant and reliable

 - Collaborate with design and backend engineering to deliver intuitive, accessible, and responsive user experiences

 - Contribute to code reviews and Agile ceremonies with our AMS team


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 3+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with strong expertise in React and TypeScript

 - Proven experience building complex, data-driven UI components including grids, forms, and dashboards in production applications

 - Experience integrating RESTful APIs into frontend applications with a solid understanding of async data fetching patterns

 - Working knowledge of modern build tooling including RsPack and pnpm, with experience shipping in CI/CD environments

 - Ability to work effectively across large timezone gaps, with regular overlap with our Australia-based team

 - US citizenship, with willingness to pursue security clearance in the future given AMS supports military and government performance programs


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You're familiar with visualization libraries like Chart.js

 - You have a background in performance-driven applications in sports tech, health, or military/tactical environments

 - You have experience working outside pure frontend, such as devops, testing, or backend

 - You have some Java background or prior experience working alongside backend Java teams


WHY THIS ROLE

AMS is a mission-critical product trusted by elite sports organizations and military programs around the world, and the frontend work ahead has real scope and real stakes. You'll have clear ownership over a layer of the product that directly shapes how coaches and performance staff do their jobs every day, on a focused team with a clear modernization roadmap.

This role exists to give Japan the dedicated attention it needs, someone who can bridge the language gap and build direct, trusted relationships with clubs and organizations across the country.

THE ROLE

 - Own the full customer lifecycle for our Japan clients, from implementation and training through renewal and expansion, across Hub, AMS, Strength & Conditioning, Recruiting, and Intelligence (Coaching & Player Personnel)

postings.title: Senior Director, Product
postings.description:
At Teamworks, we build the operating system for elite sports organizations, from D1 college football programs to professional franchises across the NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL. Our Coaching and Personnel products sit at the heart of how teams identify, develop, and manage talent, and right now we're at an inflection point. Several acquisitions have put us in position to build something no one else in this market can: a unified, AI-first platform that connects coaching workflows, talent acquisition, and on-field performance analytics into a single operating layer for elite sports.

We're hiring a Senior Director of Product to own this category end to end. This person will lead a team of PMs and product leaders across multiple markets, own the roadmap for our Coaching, Player Personnel, Recruiting, and Intelligence products, and be the face of this business unit with customers, partners, and leagues.


THE ROLE

 - Own the product strategy and roadmap across Coaching, Player Personnel, Recruiting, and Intelligence, driving coherence across a portfolio built through both organic development and acquisition

 - Define a cohesive, opinionated AI strategy that travels across football, basketball, and other sport markets. Identify the shared workflows (opponent scouting, self-scouting, talent evaluation, recruiting operations, free agency and the transfer portal, contract and scholarship decisioning) where AI agents create the most leverage, and turn that thesis into a multi-quarter roadmap

 - Lead and develop a team of product managers and product leaders operating across multiple sports markets and geographies

 - Serve as the external face of this product line, representing Teamworks in customer meetings, league partnerships, enterprise RFPs, and industry forums

 - Drive cross-functional alignment across engineering, design, data science, product marketing, GTM, and finance to move fast and ship product that wins in market

 - Stay relentlessly close to customers: front offices, coaches, coordinators, GMs, scouting directors, and league operators

 - Partner with Data Science, Engineering, and the PFF, SportLogiq, Zelus, and platform data teams to convert proprietary data into proprietary agents built on proprietary models, making deliberate calls on which capabilities are platform-level versus product-level

 - Find the workflows that look the same in football and basketball front offices and the workflows where markets genuinely diverge, building a portfolio approach that maximizes shared platform leverage without forcing one sport's mental model onto another

 - Own revenue and P&L accountability for the category, partnering with GTM to win league-wide deals and expand into new sports and international markets


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - A track record of shipping and iterating across a multi-product portfolio: not just owning one product, but driving strategy and execution across several simultaneously, with a clear point of view on where agentic AI experiences win and where traditional SaaS workflows still serve users better

 - Sports fluency: a deep understanding of how sports operate, enabling you to sit down with a GM, coach, or personnel director and credibly speak their language. This can come from many places: a genuine passion for sports that includes following the ins and outs of a given league, time spent in a front office, or experience competing as an athlete at a high level

 - Demonstrated experience leading PMs and product leaders through complex, multi-market environments (including through periods of organizational change like acquisitions or rapid growth), OR operating as a General Manager of a new business unit with full ownership of strategy, roadmap, GTM, and P&L outcomes

 - 8+ years in product management or software development within B2B SaaS, sports technology, vertical AI, or comparable industries

 - The communication and stakeholder management skills to operate credibly at the executive level, with customers and league partners, and with technical and GTM teams, all in the same week


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You've built and sold product directly to professional sports teams and understand the buying dynamics at that level

 - You have subject matter expertise in football or basketball, whether from coaching, scouting, front office, analytics, or product work in those markets

 - You've shipped AI-native features (not just AI-adjacent, but workflows where the AI is the product), with direct experience working with proprietary data sets and the models built on top of them, including the tradeoffs between in-house ML, third-party foundation models, and hybrid approaches

 - You have experience working in recently acquired or integrating product portfolios, with a bias toward action and clarity in ambiguous environments


WHY THIS ROLE

There is not a better seat in sports technology right now. Teamworks has the data, the acquisitions, and the league relationships to become the definitive AI platform for elite sports organizations, and this role sits at the center of that build. If you want to work directly with NFL, NBA, MLB, and NHL front offices while shaping a product category that doesn't exist yet in its full form, this is it.

postings.title: Manager, Engineering (Inventory Management)
postings.description:
I'm Matt Witkowicz https://www.linkedin.com/in/matt-witkowicz/, Senior Director, Engineering at Teamworks. Our Inventory Management (IM) team is in the middle of a full re-platform of our IM product, rebuilding it from the ground up from an acquired system into a modern Teamworks product, and it's picking up speed fast.

I'm hiring our first-ever Engineering Manager for this team. You'll take over ownership of how this team plans, ships, and grows, bringing structure to day-to-day execution while giving a talented early-career team the coaching and technical guidance they need to keep accelerating. You'll also help shape how we support the team in Belfast, where this group is based and where in-person leadership will matter.


THE ROLE

 - Own the IM V2 roadmap in close partnership with our Product Manager and GM of Operations, spanning both legacy IM support, net-new customer onboarding, and the ongoing migration to V2

 - Drive issue assignment, capacity planning, and milestone delivery across a Belfast-based engineering team.

 - Build and run individual growth plans for a team weighted toward apprentice and early-career engineers, including tracking apprenticeship learning requirements and helping teammates build enough practical experience to progress through their programs

 - Partner with other engineering managers across Teamworks to align on apprentice standards and support cross-team integrations


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - Strong Ruby on Rails experience, with enough React familiarity to understand the full product surface and enough technical depth to review and give substantive feedback on your team's code

 - Proven people management experience, ideally 2+ years of managing engineers across a range of skill levels

 - A background of 6+ years as a hands-on software engineer; this is not a coding-heavy role, but it does require strong technical judgment

 - Experience partnering closely with other engineering teams; Teamworks runs on strong collaboration between EMs and product owners

 - Based within a reasonable commute of Belfast; this is a hybrid role, and in-office presence will be expected a couple of days per week to support the team


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have Infrastructure as Code experience

 - You've worked hands-on with AI tooling, some of our IM V2 features are built on AI/LLMs and our team uses AI tooling day to day

 - You've had exposure to government programs like grants or apprenticeship schemes, especially in Northern Ireland or the UK


WHY THIS ROLE

You'd be the first Engineering Manager this team has ever had, building the management foundation from scratch rather than inheriting someone else's system. You'll also get real ownership over a fast-moving re-platform in a growing part of the business, while mentoring a high-potential early-career team through a meaningful stage of their development.

postings.title: Data Scientist II (Soccer)
postings.description:
We're hiring a Data Scientist II on our Soccer team to develop the statistical and machine learning models our partner clubs use for player recruitment. I'm Jacob Mortensen, Senior Manager, Data Science at Teamworks. Our team primarily focuses on building models using both player tracking data and event data to identify undervalued players and characterize the skills that make them effective. The work supports high-stakes recruitment decisions for professional clubs across global football.

The team is managing growing demand from partner clubs alongside model maintenance and new development. This hire will take ownership across the model lifecycle, from design and validation through deployment and improvement. That added capacity will help us move important initiatives forward while keeping our existing models accurate and reliable.


THE ROLE

 - 3+ years of professional or research experience developing statistical or machine learning models in Python or R, with examples of work you personally owned from problem formulation and data preparation through validation and use

 - Strong applied statistical and modeling judgment: you can select appropriate methods, explain their assumptions and trade-offs, and distinguish meaningful predictive signal from artifacts in the data

 - Experience designing rigorous model evaluations, including preventing data leakage, choosing validation strategies appropriate to temporal or grouped data, quantifying uncertainty, and assessing performance across relevant player populations and contexts

 - Experience building models with sports tracking data, including working with spatial and temporal relationships, noisy or incomplete observations, and the data-quality challenges that affect model reliability

 - Ability to write maintainable, tested, and reproducible analytical code, using version control and code review to support collaborative development

 - Proficiency in SQL to join, transform, and validate large, structured datasets used in model development

 - Experience taking models beyond exploratory notebooks into repeatable workflows or production systems, collaborating with engineering and investigating issues as models are used

 - Ability to explain modeling decisions, limitations, and results clearly to technical teammates and professional soccer clubs


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 3+ years of professional or research experience writing code in R or Python for data science, statistics, or machine learning work

 - Comfort with SQL for building and querying structured data

 - Strong data science fundamentals: you understand how models work, what they need from the data, and how to set data up to support them

 - Experience working with sports tracking data, including understanding the kinds of models typically built and the data challenges that come with them

 - Strong communication skills — you'll be explaining modeling decisions directly to partner clubs, not just internal teammates


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have direct experience with soccer data or soccer analytics (inside a team, public work, or academically)

 - You have a demonstrated track record of tackling hard problems through published research, blog posts, conference talks, or public projects

 - Experience using a cloud compute provider (e.g. AWS or Google Cloud) to train and deploy models

 - Comfort using AI coding tools, paired with the judgment to recognize when their output needs to be questioned or corrected


WHY THIS ROLE

Soccer analytics is moving quickly, and this team is helping shape how advanced modeling is used in recruitment. You'll have meaningful ownership, room to develop new approaches, and the opportunity to see your work used by professional clubs. You'll also help define how the team builds, maintains, and scales its model portfolio as demand grows.

postings.title: Senior Software Engineer (AMS)
postings.description:
We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to tackle some of the toughest performance and scalability challenges in our Athlete Management System (AMS), owning the work from initial investigation through production. I'm Charbel Al Batal, Director, Engineering at Teamworks. AMS supports elite sports and military organizations around the world and runs on a Java application with roughly twenty years of history. We’re building on that foundation to support significantly larger workloads, making thoughtful improvements where they will have the greatest impact.

We’re expanding the AMS backend team as part of a major effort to improve performance, reliability, and scale. The work includes evolving a legacy data model, reworking asynchronous processing, and strengthening observability. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys digging into complex, established systems and finding practical ways to improve them. You’ll have meaningful influence over how AMS evolves—particularly its data-access patterns, asynchronous architecture, containerization strategy, and approach to performance at scale—and customers will directly feel the impact of your work.


THE ROLE

 - Find and address performance bottlenecks across APIs, database queries, calculations, and background jobs, with a focus on improving latency, throughput, and resource use

 - Improve the data-access layer and gradually evolve a legacy data model that relies heavily on XML and JSON

 - Strengthen our queue and asynchronous processing architecture so resource-intensive workloads are separated from customer-facing traffic, calculations complete as close to real time as possible, and retries and failures are handled reliably

 - Improve monitoring and observability, establish performance baselines for large workloads, and help the team spot issues before they affect customers

 - Operate with a high degree of independence, turning broad performance and scalability goals into technical plans and driving them through production

 - Partner with our Data Platform team as AMS becomes an early consumer of Teamworks’ evolving data platform, helping integrate new data capabilities into an established application

 - Serve as a trusted technical partner to engineering leadership by reviewing complex architectural changes, mentoring engineers, and helping the team balance immediate scaling needs with longer-term improvements


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 6+ years of backend engineering experience, including ownership of complex systems from design through production

 - Strong Java skills and hands-on experience working with and improving established codebases

 - Experience with PostgreSQL, RESTful API design, and performance optimization at scale

 - Experience operating backend applications in AWS and working effectively with containerized infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code tooling

 - US citizenship and US-based residency, which are required for access to the secure environment supported by this role

 - Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation


EVEN BETTER IF

 - Experience moving monolithic applications toward containerized or service-oriented architectures

 - Experience in data-intensive, high-scale, or security-sensitive environments

 - Experience with Python

 - A strong understanding of the JVM, including how to troubleshoot memory and CPU issues under load

 - A DevOps background and deep experience with AWS

 - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field


WHY THIS ROLE

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a well-established product used by elite sports and military organizations around the world. The challenges are complex, the work has a clear impact, and you’ll have meaningful ownership over how AMS grows and performs. It’s a strong fit for someone who likes solving difficult backend problems and wants to see those improvements make a difference for customers.



This role is not eligible for sponsorship at this time.

postings.title: Senior Marketing Operations Manager
postings.description:
We're hiring a Senior Marketing Operations Manager to build the attribution and tracking foundation that gives us a trusted picture of marketing's influence across the customer journey, and to lead the shift from manual campaign and event work into automation. I'm Karla Anderson https://www.linkedin.com/in/karla-anderson/, EVP, Marketing at Teamworks, and this role reports directly to me. Marketing operations has lived in different places across the company over the past few years, and I'm bringing it back under one clear owner inside marketing. With 25 products across multiple markets, connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue is complex. Getting it right takes someone who understands both the mechanics of marketing operations and the nuance of enterprise B2B attribution. You'll map our journey end to end, from campaigns and events to website engagement and in-app messaging, and build the tracking infrastructure that lets us trust the numbers behind the funnel.

This is also a chance to shape what an AI-native marketing function looks like at Teamworks. We want a team that builds automation and agents into how we work, not as a side experiment, but as core infrastructure that scales campaign execution, list building, and reporting across demand gen and product marketing. You'll have real ownership here and the freedom to build this function largely from scratch.


THE ROLE

 - Map end-to-end marketing attribution and build the tracking that shows how demand gen and product marketing campaigns influence pipeline and revenue

 - Own the systems and setup behind every campaign, event, and in-app message, including list building and lifecycle triggers, so tracking works correctly from day one

 - Lead the shift from manual campaign and project work into automated workflows, freeing our team to focus on strategy instead of setup

 - Partner with Tech Ops and RevOps to keep marketing data clean and aligned across the stack, without duplicating work already happening elsewhere

 - Build our AI native marketing function, designing and shipping the automations and agents that scale work across demand gen and product marketing


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 4-5 years running marketing operations in a complex, enterprise B2B environment, not a startup or single-product business, because Teamworks' multi-product, multi-market structure makes attribution genuinely harder to map

 - A track record of building marketing attribution and campaign tracking from scratch, not just maintaining systems someone else designed

 - Direct experience shifting marketing work from manual to automated, including AI-built automations or agents, not just using AI tools day to day

 - Working knowledge of the marketing tech stack, including how campaign, CRM, and in-app messaging systems connect and where data breaks down

 - Comfort operating as a team of one, owning strategy and execution without a team to delegate to, at least initially


EVEN BETTER IF

 - Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, or customer.io or an equivalent in-app messaging platform

 - Familiarity with website analytics tools like Google Analytics and how to tie web behavior into the broader attribution picture

 - Background in sports, media, or another complex vertical


WHY THIS ROLE

This function doesn't exist yet in its current form, which means you get to define it. You'll set the standard for how marketing operations runs at Teamworks, build the attribution model the business will use to judge marketing's contribution to revenue, and help lead the shift into an AI native way of working, all while operating across a genuinely complex, global, multi-product business.

postings.title: Senior Account Executive I (Performance, Pro, North America)
postings.description:
We're hiring a Senior Account Executive I (Performance, Pro, North America) to build and scale a dedicated commercial motion across Teamworks' Performance product line for Pro and Enterprise sports organizations. I'm Nick Walsh https://www.linkedin.com/in/nick-walsh-3ba07139, Head of Performance (Sales) at Teamworks.

The Pro/Enterprise performance market is one of the fastest-growing segments in sports technology, and we're sharpening our focus to go after it the right way. That means building a dedicated motion around our Performance product line, led by AMS and EMR and backed by Strength & Conditioning and Nutrition, with someone who has used these products from inside a performance department, not just sold around one. This is not a traditional sales role. We're looking for a practitioner-turned-commercial professional who has held a senior performance leadership position inside a Professional Team, Enterprise organization, or a national/state high-performance institute, and who understands what it takes to build, run, and scale a performance operation because they've done it themselves.


THE ROLE

 - Own and grow a pipeline of Pro and Enterprise prospects across the full Performance category, with AMS, EMR, Strength & Conditioning, Nutrition, and Kitchen as your leading product set

 - Lead consultative discovery conversations with VPs of Health and Performance, Directors of Performance, Head Athletic Trainers, Strength Coaches, and Registered Dietitians

 - Partner with our Customer Success team to identify expansion and renewal opportunities within existing Pro and Enterprise accounts

 - Represent Teamworks at Pro and Enterprise-specific industry events, conferences, and site visits

 - Provide market intelligence back to Product and Marketing based on your practitioner network and field experience


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - Hands-on performance experience inside a Professional Club, Enterprise organization, or national/state high-performance institute, in any sport, because your credibility with performance leaders is the foundation of this role

 - Deep, firsthand experience actually using an Athlete Management System (AMS) and/or Strength & Conditioning platform in your day-to-day work, with the ability to navigate the system fluently, demo it credibly, and speak to where AI and emerging technology are taking these tools

 - A Master's degree in a Performance-related sports discipline

 - Deep understanding of how Pro and Enterprise programs make budget and purchasing decisions, including who holds influence at different levels within a sporting organization

 - Based in North America, with a natural network across the Pro and Enterprise performance community and comfort managing a complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycle in a fast-moving, target-driven environment


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have existing relationships within a specific Pro league, conference, or national high-performance institute network

 - You've been through enterprise-level procurement or RFP processes from the inside

 - You have experience presenting to executive or ownership-level stakeholders


WHY THIS ROLE

You'll get to stay in the sport you've built your career around, without the grind of a season on the road. Instead of building one program, you'll help dozens of them level up, working across the Pro and Enterprise landscape with the backing of a market-leading product suite and a team that speaks your language. It's also a chance to build relationships far beyond the sport you came from, connecting with performance leaders across the wider Pro and Enterprise community.

postings.title: Product Manager II (Soccer)
postings.description:
We're hiring a Product Manager to own and scale Player ID, Teamworks' soccer talent identification product. Player ID builds on technology proven with elite clubs and helps teams turn complex player data into better scouting, recruitment, and squad-building decisions. I'm Paul Gagnon, Manager, Product at Teamworks.

This is a build-and-scale role with true ownership. You'll bring an established product into the broader Teamworks platform, shape it for a wider global market, and work across Data Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, and go-to-market teams to turn sophisticated data into a product clubs can use and trust.


THE ROLE

 - Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle for Player ID, from product strategy and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and iteration, with soccer as your core market

 - Partner with Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Product, and Product Engineering to turn complex player data and models into clear, actionable product experiences for clubs

 - Bring proven legacy capabilities into the Teamworks platform, shaping the product experience, roadmap, and packaging without starting from scratch

 - Work with Sales, Customer Success, and Product Success to understand the market, balance client feedback with a strong product point of view, and scale Player ID across global soccer markets

 - Engage directly with club analysts, scouts, and sporting directors to understand how they work and validate the product


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR


WHAT YOU MUST BRING

 - 5+ years of professional product management experience owning and shipping a product used by external customers, ideally one with meaningful technical or data complexity

 - The technical fluency to engage credibly across the full product lifecycle, from raw data and models through APIs, workflows, and the front-end experience

 - Experience owning a product end to end in a B2B SaaS environment, from strategy and discovery through delivery and adoption

 - Strong product judgment and a history of taking ownership for outcomes, especially when information is incomplete and alignment must be built across teams

 - Ability to influence without authority and align data, engineering, and commercial partners around a clear product direction

 - Experience using product analytics (usage data, funnels, feature adoption, retention) to find insights and turn them into roadmap decisions, and to measure whether shipped work changed customer outcomes


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You've taken a technical or data-rich product from one industry or customer segment and successfully adapted it to a new, specialized market

 - You have professional experience with soccer and have built products to inform how how clubs use data to make scouting, talent identification, recruitment, or squad planning decisions

 - You've worked in a startup or growth-stage environment where you influenced without authority, navigated ambiguity, and moved quickly with limited structure

 - You have real world experience using AI tools to improve/empower your own product work (discovery, specs, analysis, prototyping)


WHY THIS ROLE

Player ID is not a greenfield idea waiting to be validated. It builds on a product already used by elite clubs and on Teamworks' proven experience supporting player personnel decisions in other sports. You'll have the opportunity to own the product end to end, shape how complex soccer data becomes useful to clubs, and scale it into a broader global market where the competitive advantage of data is still being defined.

postings.description:
We are hiring two exceptional MBA students to join our Strategy team for the summer of 2027. The ideal candidate will be in the process of completing an MBA from a top-tier business school and have at least three years of relevant work experience in delivering significant strategic and operational impact across an organization. The person in this role will work across the business and contribute to both product and market growth.

This role is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to help pioneer the next frontier in sports and contribute to the continued rapid scaling of one of the world’s fastest-growing sports tech companies.

This internship is open to candidates based remotely in the U.S. or in-person out of our Durham office.


THE ROLE

 - Drive growth for our current (and future) markets and products, conduct internal/external research and provide rigorous, fact-based, quantitative analysis to support recommendations on where we should focus our investments to fuel growth

 - Provide project leadership through strong day-to-day operational execution, helping evolve early-stage ideas into future-growth initiatives

 - Develop solutions to complex, ambiguous, and high-visibility business problems and opportunities

 - Deliver high-quality output by working independently and partnering closely with stakeholders across products, markets, and functional groups

 - Develop business cases and build market models to evaluate new business opportunities, pricing strategies, and product expansion initiatives

 - Analyze pricing, packaging, and retention data to recommend how we price, bundle, and expand products across customer segments


WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

 - In the process of completing an MBA from a top-tier business school

 - 3+ years of relevant work experience in roles delivering significant strategic impact across an organization (e.g. experience at a top-tier consulting firm focused on strategy and implementation; a role on a corporate strategy or business operations team at a technology company; experience building financial models and delivering insights at an investment bank)

 - Proficient with Excel / Google Sheets, PowerPoint / Google Slides, and building compelling presentations


EVEN BETTER IF

 - You have experience in sports or high-growth B2B SaaS

 - Proven experience leading and influencing cross-functional teams, including when colleagues are not direct reports
